title: Pleural Effusion Drainage in Mechanically Ventilated Patients Monitored by EIT
brief_summary: Evacuation of pleural effusion (PE) represents a disputable therapy in mechanically ventilated patients. Patients on mechanical ventilation indicated by the physician to pleural fluid evacuation will be monitored throughout the procedure by electrical impedance tomography (EIT) and concurrently end-expiratory lung volume (EELV) will be measured in order to describe impact of PE evacuation on aeration and ventilation of the lungs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mechanical ventilation, presence of pleural effusion, decision of the treating physician to drain it

Exclusion Criteria:

* impossibility to apply EIT belt or to find suitable save point for drainage when the EIT belt is attached
* standard EIT exclusion criteria according to the device manufacturer
